description: Produces interface images from an audited UI checklist, to the ui style guide: icons, frames, nine-slices, button and cursor states, at every scale the platforms need. Writes to staging; does not wire anything up.
when_to_use: a UI checklist exists and the interface art has to be made
icons, frames or button states have to be produced
avoid_when: the files exist and only need importing
the request is to change how a screen behaves
outputs: UI images in the staging area
